How to connect Facebook leads

Prototype-ready workflow for real lead automation.

Manual nowCopy a Facebook lead into this form and save it. Then convert it to a client.
Automatic laterConnect Facebook Lead Ads → Zapier/Make → Balenco database. New leads can appear automatically.
Website form laterAdd a quote request form to your company website and send submissions into Balenco.
